name: Onboard USD Card
summary: Virtual USD card with $3 one-time creation fee. Zero deposit fees. $5K daily / $20K monthly limits. 2% + $0.5 for non-USD transactions.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Onboard USD Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$3.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Onboard USD Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.
